sermon.title: The River of the Spirit Doing a New Thing with Paul 09/01/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer turns to Paul and 1 Corinthians 14 to describe a Spirit-empowered, orderly church service. Gifts and love work together; tongues should not be forbidden; every member comes with something to contribute. The word, prophecy, prayer in the Spirit and full worship convict hearts, so an unbeliever declares that God is truly among you.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.
